items.topic: Custom object for signups, not Lead
items.statement: Per Gemini notes, Kobi objected to using the Lead object for signups and proposed a custom object linked to Contacts instead. The Gemini Decisions section states this as a firm decision; the Details section states it only as Kobi's proposal, and no client was present.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran expressed an objection to using the "Lead" object for signups, proposing instead to use a custom object linked to contacts to improve data management and linking.
items.note: Gemini notes only; not usable as sole evidence for a decision; Gemini Decisions line 34 says 'The team will utilize a custom object for signups instead of the standard Salesforce Lead object' (firmer than Details line 60, which says 'proposing'). Internal Jumpr meeting only; not client-confirmed.
